name: Cluster-4-500K-Connections
comments: AWS four-node cluster: node-a 172.31.13.230, node-b 172.31.13.222, node-c 172.31.8.125, node-d 172.31.11.169; MQTT 1884 on each.
500000 clients at 5000 connections/second, distributed evenly over the four nodes (125000 each).
Run on the AWS client c5n.4xlarge with 29 bound source addresses, anonymous MQTT connections.
The same file is used for XMQ and EMQX: the four nodes are rebuilt with one broker at a time and keep their addresses, so only the broker changes.
Nodes c5n.2xlarge, one AZ us-east-1a; node-a also hosts the cluster's PostgreSQL and Redis.
